sentences.text: First dates.
A first date can make you feel excited, but also a little nervous, especially if you are speaking in English.
Don't worry, I am here to help.
The first few minutes of a date are very important.
You want to make a good first impression.
Here are some simple ways to introduce yourself.
Greeting your date.
Hi, it's so nice to meet you.
Hello, how are you?
I've been looking forward to this.
You look great.
Introducing yourself.
I'm your name.
It's great to finally meet you.
So tell me a little about yourself.
I heard a lot about you.
I'm excited to get to know you better.
Starting with a warm greeting and a compliment helps create a good atmosphere.
Two, common questions to ask on a first date.
Asking questions is a great way to get to know your date.
Here are some simple and natural questions you can ask.
Basic questions.
Where are you from?
What do you do for work?
What do you like to do in your free time?
Fun and interesting questions.
Do you like traveling?
What's your favorite place you've been to?
What kind of movies or music do you like?
Do you have any pets?
Deeper questions.
What's something you're really passionate about?
If you could travel anywhere in the world, where would you go?
What's the best advice you've ever received?
Asking open -ended questions helps keep the conversation interesting.
Three, how to keep the conversation going.
Good conversations on a date should feel natural and fun.
Here are some phrases to keep the conversation going.
Showing interest.
That sounds really interesting.
Wow, I'd love to hear more about that.
That's so cool.
How did you get into that?
Reacting naturally.
Oh really?
That's amazing.
I didn't know that.
Tell me more.
That's funny.
I love that story.
If you show interest in ask follow -up questions, your date will enjoy talking to you.
Four, giving compliments.
Giving a sincere compliment can make your date feel special.
Here are some natural ways to compliment your date.
You have a great smile.
I really like your style.
You're so easy to talk to.
You have a great sense of humor.
I love your energy.
It's really positive.
A small compliment can make your date feel appreciated.
Five, ordering food and drinks in English.
If you are at a restaurant or cafe on a date, you may need to order food.
Here are some useful phrases.
At a cafe or restaurant, are you ready to order?
Yes, I'll have a coffee please.
Can I get a salad with chicken?
I'd like the pasta please.
Would you like dessert?
Yes, let's get something sweet.
No, thank you.
I'm full.
Ordering food in English is easy with these simple phrases.
Six, what to say at the end of the date?
When the date is ending, you want to leave a good impression.
Here are some polite and friendly ways to end the date.
If you had a good time, I had a great time with you today.
It was really nice getting to know you.
I'd love to see you again.
Let's do this again soon.
If you want to say goodbye politely, it was nice meeting you.
Take care.
I had a nice time.
Have a great night.
Thanks for the lovely evening.
A positive and friendly goodbye leaves a good impression.
First date conversation practice.
